note: 0.4 dev.37 (Osama, 6 November 2026). No missile ripple fire: every ATGM weapon (types 80, 81, 89) fires 1 missile per burst, and no more missiles are guided at once than targets tracked, so 1 missile per target. Covers every Kornet launcher (Kornet-EM, Epokha, T-15 Barbaris, Tigr Kornet, Kornet-D1, Bumerang Kornet-M), Khrizantema, Vikhr, Hellfire and Griffin. SAMs and air-to-air missiles are not changed. T-80UM-2 Drozd variant retired (structural-contract). Javelin aim 3-4 s (dev30-contract). Not deployed. 0.6 (Lateralus, 8 November 2026): the helicopter launchers Vikhr x6 (107), Hellfire F&F x4 (647) and Hellfire JAGM-MR x4 (1029) keep their vanilla bursts and tracking (helicopter ATGMs back to vanilla); they are listed in 'helicopter_vanilla'.
